team.title: Team
team.description: Invite people, choose their role and hand over ownership.

members.title: Members
members.description: Owner: company and team. Admin: contacts and viewers. Viewer: searches and contacts, without managing them.

changeRole.title: Change role of {{name}}
changeRole.description: Choose the access this person needs.

transfer.title: Transfer ownership
transfer.description: The new owner manages the company, its language and the team, and can delete the company. You become an Admin, and only the new owner can undo this.
transfer.nobody: Nobody else is in the team yet. Invite someone first, then transfer ownership to them.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: Each link works only for the invited email address and expires after 7 days.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.description: They get an email with a link and sign in with Google or a link sent to the same address.

errors.member: This person is already in the team.
errors.invited: This person already has a pending invitation.

hints.admin: Admins manage contacts and can invite or remove viewers.
hints.viewer: Viewers run searches and see contacts, without managing them.
hints.adminInvitesViewers: As an admin you can invite viewers.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: {{name}} loses access to {{company}} and their account is deleted, together with the invitations they sent. Searches they ran stay with the company.

revoke.title: Revoke the invitation for {{email}}?
revoke.body: The invitation link stops working straight away. You can invite them again later.

notices.ownershipTransferred: Ownership transferred to {{name}}. You're now an Admin.
notices.memberRemoved: {{name}} was removed and their account deleted.
notices.invitationRevoked: Invitation revoked. The link no longer works.
